items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer: The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. The original agreement states that "This Agreement continues until terminated" [1].

An amendment to the agreement was signed, but it does not introduce a fixed end date. Instead, it confirms that "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [2].

No other document in the matter provides information about a fixed end date for the Kestrel storage agreement.

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated
All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The term "Storage Services Agreement" in Amendment No. 1 refers to the original agreement between Voss-Lindqvist AB and Kestrel Cold Storage Ltd. According to the amendment, all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force [1].

The original Storage Services Agreement includes terms such as the provision of storage services, the monthly storage fee, and the term and termination clause. The monthly storage fee was initially set at EUR 4,000 [3]. The term of the agreement was that it continues until terminated [3].

Amendment No. 1 changes the monthly storage fee to EUR 4,600 [7], but it confirms that all other terms of the original agreement remain in force.

evidence.quote: All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: The documents do not provide certainty about the exact time the alarm sounded. Jonas Ekberg states, "I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute" [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute.

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000. This is stated in the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, which specifies: "Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month" [2].

Amendment No. 1, which took effect on 1 June 2026, changed this amount to EUR 4,600 [1].
